values.note: Fairfax County Park Authority 2026 table: 20/30-amp sites $40 weekdays, $44 weekends/holidays; 20/30/50-amp $50/$55; non-electric sites ($32/$37) are tent-only on the booking site. A 9% county transient occupancy tax is added from May 1, 2026 (the booking site quoted a 20/30-amp site at $43.60 for Tue 2026-11-03). Dump station free for registered campers.

fees.source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/parks/lake-fairfax/camping (Camping Fees table, '*Effective May 1, 2026, a 9% Fairfax County transient occupancy tax') + https://fairfaxrdr.usedirect.com/FCPARDR/RDR/search/details (booking-site quote for Mixed Use (Electric) #2, 2026-11-03), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/parks/lake-fairfax/camping ('RV electrical hookups (30 and 50 amp)'; 'Fresh water fill-up station (no water on sites)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booking site lists 93 units: 30 RV Only (Full Electric), 10 Mixed Use (Full Electric), 14 Mixed Use (Electric, 20/30 amp), 18 Tent Only (Non-Electric), 21 small/large group sites. Sampled pads: 55 ft (RV Only #1) and 48 ft (Mixed Use Electric #2), both back-in. 'Spacious campsites that are both big-rig and tent friendly.'

sites.source: https://fairfaxrdr.usedirect.com/FCPARDR/RDR/search/grid (FacilityId 3163, the Lake Fairfax 'Reserve' link) + unit details pages, read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/parks/lake-fairfax/camping ('Restrooms and showers'; 'Fresh water fill-up station'; 'Dump station use is complimentary for registered campers') + booking-site unit amenities ('Flushing toilets', 'Hot Showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: RV sites (30 and 50 amp) open year-round; tent and group camping April 1 - November 30 only.

season.source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/parks/sites/parks/files/Assets/documents/waterfront/campsite-reservation-guide.pdf ('OPEN YEAR-ROUND: 50 & 30 amp RV, 5th Wheel and Travel Trailer sites'; 'OPEN APRIL-NOVEMBER: Tent, Large and Small Group Camping Sites') + camping page ('Tent and Group camping is open April 1-November 30 only'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booking site restrictions: bookable from today to 12 months ahead, 1-14 nights. Stay limits: 14 consecutive days April-October, 28 December-March (RV only). '2-night minimum stay required on holidays' (Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day). Changes/cancellations free 60+ days out, $25 fee 14-59 days, first night lost 3-13 days, first two nights lost within 2 days. Check in at the park's main office.

booking.source: https://fairfaxrdr.usedirect.com/FCPARDR/RDR/search/grid (Restrictions: FutureBookingEnds 2027-10-21, MaximumStay 14) + https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/parks/lake-fairfax/camping + reservation guide PDF (Stay Limits), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed fees $40-55 (2026 table; $32 non-electric sites are tent-only). Added 50-amp electric with no water at sites, 93 units (54 electric RV-capable, pads 48-55 ft sampled), showers/flush toilets/water fill/dump, RV sites year-round (tents Apr-Nov), USEdirect booking 12 months out, 14-night max (28 Dec-Mar), 2-night holiday minimum. Sewer, pull-throughs and overall max length not stated.
